title: Gibbons calls in Pandolfi to brief on the Rockefeller Initiative

tellings.quote: this stuff. So Gibbons calls in M he calls in Ron Pendalfi to do the briefing and this has been established that Ron was called to do the briefing.

plain: In the 1990s, when the Rockefeller Initiative, a push linked to the Rockefeller name for the Clinton White House to look into UFOs and the 1947 Roswell crash, reached the White House, John Gibbons called in a man named Ron Pandolfi to give the briefing on it. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this and insists "this has been established," without naming how. The point for him is that the White House took the UFO question seriously enough to call in a briefer.
